status: prospective replacement of an undefined closed-form adaptation objective, not a bug-only repair
hypothesis: Train-only extent supervision through the actual final-layer LayerNorm and existing PageReader scalar value equation can produce final pooled features whose fixed linear readout transfers to development page texts.
basis: C1 execution stopped before its solve. Its scalar extent target cannot define the proposed 384-wide output-weight target. Masked mean is linear before LayerNorm but final pooled features are nonlinear in that weight. No C1 quality score was obtained. A gradient prerequisite tests the actual existing scalar function without inventing hidden-vector targets.

data.train: Exactly the same 180 unique supervised train page texts and scalar raw grade targets used by the retired ceiling; hash-indexed using components.supervised_unique and the existing training optimizer indices.
data.development: Exactly the same 240 unique development page texts; only the CPU ceiling evaluates their grades after prerequisite training ends.
data.validation: Forbidden in prerequisite fitting or selection.
data.grouping: Existing authored property/family grouping and unique text hash deduplication unchanged; one target per text must agree exactly. Population counts and hashes are asserted before fitting.

adaptation.encoder: Same pinned cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-xsmall, revision a150876415327c80daeff35ca6f68f5ed8cf5c24, FP32.
adaptation.surface: Same final transformer layer11 plus six multiplicative per-weight adapters initialized to one. Embeddings and layers0-10 remain frozen.
adaptation.reader: Existing PageReader sigmoid(wv(normalized_page_feature)); initialize from the pinned pages checkpoint, train only its existing wv weight and bias. No added head, no hidden-vector target.
adaptation.loss: Existing raw grade MSE component, equal weight per unique train page text. This prerequisite intentionally uses only the grade component, not the full four-component decision objective. The later full development fit still uses all four unchanged components.
adaptation.normalizer: Existing train-only common q/page mean/std with floor0.01, verified against pinned checkpoint; fixed throughout.
adaptation.batch_order: Fixed unique train-text order from the existing supervised_unique rows; accumulate chunk sum squared errors divided by total180 before one step.
adaptation.checkpoint: Final epoch400 only; no early stopping, no checkpoint selection, no dev-selected hyperparameter.
adaptation.encoder_mode: eval mode during training, as the existing adaptation smoke; autograd remains enabled for final layer and adapters.
adaptation.cache: Optionally cache detached inputs to frozen layer11 once on train texts. Replay must match the complete actual encoder output at initialization under identical batch layout within existing1e-5 tolerance. Directly execute the actual final layer, including its attention, residuals, bias and LayerNorm; no surrogate. Cache is process-local, invalidated for a changed frozen-base hash.

controls: A smoke, B byte immutability and narrowed C0 liveness/restore must already pass
One finite backward and nonzero gradients into layer11, all six adapters and wv before400-step run
Frozen subset parameter hash checked before and after each update
Cached-final-layer replay checked against actual full encoder at init
Final prerequisite state reloaded on CPU with strict state_dict and source/population hash checks before ceiling
primary_metric: CPU FP64 bias-free linear readout development unique-text equal-family macro raw unclipped MAE
solver: Same numpy.linalg.lstsq(rcond=None), same train-only normalization and independent scipy GELSS/residual checks
statistics: Finite fixed-inventory deterministic gate, no IID confidence or semantic-absence claim. Persist raw per-text targets, predictions and family membership for independent reconstruction; inherited downstream world-cluster bootstrap applies only if full development fit is reached.

failure_branches.execution_or_invariant: Fail closed; retain failure without interpreting it as model quality; fix only demonstrated implementation defects.
failure_branches.C1_quality_fail: Retire this bounded grade-supervised adaptation prerequisite for the assay. Do not run the full development fit, do not widen capacity or change threshold. This does not falsify all encoder adaptation or the autonomous endgame; preregister a new evidence-justified architecture/task branch under the master mandate.
failure_branches.C1_quality_pass: Permit the existing full four-component development fit with original seed, epochs, loss, learning rates and parent gate set. No promotion; passing full gates and mechanism claims requires replication and fresh audited final protocol.

resource_budget: One serialized local GPU job under /tmp/vey-gpu.lock, at most400 updates on180 unique texts; cache frozen prefix inputs where verified. One CPU ceiling run after. Existing nice10, ionice2/7, thread caps and memory/swap guard retained. No paid resources.
persist: Source and protocol hashes and git revision before optimizer
Input text digests, row/property/family IDs, target arrays and token arrays/hashes under vey-data only
Final adapted encoder plus wv and fixed normalizer
CPU C1 raw features, targets, predictions and metrics
forbidden: Changing authored inputs, targets, splits or quality threshold
Using development, validation or final for adaptation fitting or selection
Calling the changed prerequisite a bug-only fix
Claiming full adaptation family is falsified by a finite negative
